lines.zh: 我从王座上起身，一步一步。
lines.en: I rise from the throne and take one step at a time.
This hall has held me a long while.
My foot lands and the flagstones crack.

lines.zh: 我沿着厅堂的边走到中间。
lines.en: I walk from the hall's edge to its middle.
Light leaks out of me.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，门就在那里。
lines.en: I don't hurry. The door is there.

lines.zh: 无数年了，我还是这副样子。
lines.en: Countless years, and I'm still this shape.

lines.zh: 王座厅的火把，映出我的两重影。
lines.en: The throne hall's torches cast my double shadow.
Each step pushes the fog back a foot.

lines.zh: 我朝着有活物气息的方向走。
lines.en: I walk toward the smell of something alive.

lines.zh: 我坐在王座上，一动不动。
lines.en: I sit on the throne and don't move.
Golden light falls from my shoulders.
I wasn't always like this.

lines.zh: 那副旧身体，早就烧掉了。
lines.en: That old body burned away long ago.
There's no road behind the throne.
This hall is my cage.
I raise my head to the vault above.
No one ever comes here.

lines.zh: 我数过厅里的每一块砖。
lines.en: I've counted every stone in this hall.
Fog seeps up through the floor.

lines.zh: 王座厅里没有食物，也不需要。
lines.en: No food in the throne hall, and none needed.
This power never runs low.
I close my fist slowly.

lines.zh: 外面的世界，我还记得一点。
lines.en: I remember a little of the world outside.
It no longer looks the same.

lines.zh: 我等，等有人推开那扇门。
lines.en: I wait for someone to push that door.
You pushed that door open.

lines.zh: 我的王座还空着，你看见了。
lines.en: My throne still stands empty; you see it.

lines.zh: 这座王座厅，不欢迎活人。
lines.en: This throne hall does not welcome the living.
And yet you came.

lines.zh: 我站起来，厅堂就暗了一截。
lines.en: I stand, and the hall dims a little.

lines.zh: 封在这里太久，名字旧了。
lines.en: Sealed in here so long, my name has worn old.

lines.zh: 我不用看也知道你的分量。
lines.en: I know your weight without looking.

lines.zh: 我的名字，你大概没听过。
lines.en: You probably haven't heard my name.

lines.zh: 封在这里太久，名字也旧了。
lines.en: Sealed here so long, even the name is stale.
To leave, you come through me.
You stepped back. I stayed.
The door is behind you. I know.

lines.zh: 这点伤，石头都替我挡了。
lines.en: The stone took most of that.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，砖碎了一片。
lines.en: I take half a step; flagstones shatter.

lines.zh: 王座厅的柱子，震落一层灰。
lines.en: Dust falls from the throne hall's pillars.

lines.zh: 我的光晃了一下，又稳了。
lines.en: My light flickered, then steadied.

lines.zh: 五百年了，第一次觉得疼。
lines.en: Five hundred years, and the first pain.

lines.zh: 王座厅封着我，掌心发亮。
lines.en: Sealed in my throne hall, my palm glows.
So it can still be like this.
I brace on the throne and steady myself.
Not finished. Come on.
You struck me. I'm still standing.
That does nothing for me.

lines.zh: 我已经不是那副身体了。
lines.en: I'm no longer that body.
You hold it out like feeding livestock.
I stopped eating long ago.
Put it down. Don't waste it.

lines.zh: 神不吃饭，你自己留着吧。
lines.en: Gods do not eat; keep it yourself.

lines.zh: 这厅堂里，什么都不会长。
lines.en: Nothing grows in this hall.

lines.zh: 你带着吃的进来，很天真。
lines.en: Bringing food in here is naive.
I don't need it. Keep it.

lines.zh: 祭品也好，食物也好，我不需要。
lines.en: Offering or food, I need neither.
You ran into me and were thrown back.
My plates are thicker than they look.
You went back three steps and held.

lines.zh: 我坐在自己的王座厅里。
lines.en: I sit in my own throne hall.

lines.zh: 厅堂太小，我们挤在一起。
lines.en: The hall is too small. We crowd.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，风就把你推开了。
lines.en: I turned and the wind shoved you aside.

lines.zh: 地上那块砖碎了，你小心。
lines.en: That flagstone cracked. Watch your step.
Your hand shook when you touched me.
There's nowhere here to retreat.
So you go forward.
Something like me has none of that.
I used to have another shape.
Back then I could still feel cold.
Not anymore.
You want to stay here with me?

lines.zh: 这间厅堂会把你留下来。
lines.en: This hall will keep you.
Not the way you imagine.
I'd advise against staying.
Go, while the door's still open.
The door's open. I won't follow.

lines.zh: 我脚下这块地砖，裂开了。
lines.en: The floor tile under my foot splits.
Everything is small in my hands.

lines.zh: 我封在王座厅里，五百年。
lines.en: Sealed in my throne hall for five hundred years.
This was alive once, wasn't it.
I set it by the throne.

lines.zh: 厅堂里，这些东西只会积灰。
lines.en: In this hall such things only gather dust.
Yours. Take it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，王座都跟着响。
lines.en: When I bend, even the throne creaks.
I don't feel the weight.
Put it back.
Did you hear? The door closed.
Not by me.
This hall doesn't want you to leave.
It wants you kept. So do I.

lines.zh: 地砖在我脚下塌了一寸。
lines.en: The tiles sink an inch under my step.

lines.zh: 砌在这里的石头，都在响。
lines.en: The stones set in this hall are ringing.
Light spreads out from me.

lines.zh: 我坐在自己的王座上，别想让我起来。
lines.en: I sit on my own throne; I will not rise.

lines.zh: 这点距离，对我等于没有。
lines.en: That gap means nothing to me.
But I'll give you time.
Try walking to the door.
See if it opens.
See how far you get.

lines.zh: 你的名字，写进神的名单了。
lines.en: Your name is written on a god's list.
The first. I've counted.
The second. Don't stop.
The third. Now it's my turn.
Three counted. My turn.

lines.zh: 我走过长廊，甲片擦着石壁。
lines.en: I cross the long hall, armor scraping stone.

lines.zh: 火焰在我掌心聚成一团。
lines.en: Fire gathers in my palm.
My light is on the walls.
You've run to the far end.
That door is sealed.
Push it. It won't move.
I stop and watch you push.
You can't move it. As you like.
You have plenty of strength.
When it's spent, I'm still here.
The fog in the hall is thickening.
You can't see me clearly.
The shape in the fog. I'm here.
No. Here.

lines.zh: 你转过身，我又换了地方。
lines.en: You turn, and I've moved again.
An old trick.
I've never had the chance to use it.
Unused so long. Now I have the chance.
Stand. Don't shift again.
This bout ends here.
On my throne, the fire never dies.
The flagstones break apart.
Half my strength on that one.
You're thrown back into a pillar.

lines.zh: 前一任的挑战者，也站在这。
lines.en: The last challenger stood there too.
He never left through that door.

lines.zh: 前一任没撑住，你比他稳。
lines.en: The last one didn't hold. You're steadier.
That's all.
I raise my hand; light gathers in the palm.
This light will burn you clean.
I've tried it on myself.
I tried it on myself. No use.
Maybe it works on you.
Don't sway. Hold still.

lines.zh: 厅堂的灯，一盏盏亮起来。
lines.en: The hall's lamps light one by one.

lines.zh: 王座上有个人形，慢慢站起来。
lines.en: A figure on the throne rises slowly.
The one on the throne is me.
I've been sealed here a long time.

lines.zh: 每一步，都像从石头里拔出来。
lines.en: Each step feels pulled from stone.
Golden light leaks from my plate seams.
Fog spills out behind me.

lines.zh: 这间厅堂，是我自己造的。
lines.en: I built this hall myself.
And sealed it myself.

lines.zh: 曾经我只是一只小火兽。
lines.en: Once I was only a small fire-beast.
Then I burned into a god.
Even gods get locked away.
You pushed the door and I woke.
Now you may look at me.
This face. Look closely.
No one has seen this face in a long while.

lines.zh: 王座厅的门，在我身后关上。
lines.en: The throne hall door shuts behind me.

lines.zh: 我封在王座厅里，等你来开。
lines.en: Sealed in my throne hall, I wait for you to open it.
Want out? Then try.

lines.zh: 这扇门，我等你等了太久。
lines.en: I've waited far too long at this door.

lines.zh: 火对我无效，我就是从火里出来的。
lines.en: Fire is no use. I came out of fire.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，厅堂响了一声。
lines.en: I fell from height; the hall boomed once.

lines.zh: 水汽漫上来，我的光暗了一格。
lines.en: Steam rises and my light dims a notch.
The blast tilted the throne itself.

lines.zh: 那东西嵌进我的旧甲里。
lines.en: It's embedded in my old plates.
This divine force is older than mine.
Enthroned, I am a god.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，像回了家。
lines.en: Lightning on me feels like coming home.

lines.zh: 这里没有厅堂，也没有王座。
lines.en: No hall here. No throne.
